name: Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: 2010 Revised Task Force Criteria for ARVC

criteria.description: Regional right ventricular akinesia, dyskinesia or aneurysm with global RV dilatation or reduced ejection fraction on imaging
Fibrofatty replacement of myocardium on endomyocardial biopsy
Inverted T waves in right precordial leads (V1-V3) in individuals >14 years old without right bundle branch block
Sustained or nonsustained ventricular tachycardia of left bundle branch block morphology
Confirmed pathogenic mutation in ARVC-related gene or family history of ARVC

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Diagnosis requires 2 major criteria or 1 major plus 2 minor criteria or 4 minor criteria from different categories
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is based on a combination of structural, histological, electrocardiographic, arrhythmic, and genetic factors.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Ventricular tachycardia with left bundle branch block morphology
pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic arrhythmia originating from the right ventricle

pathognomonic.symptomName: Fibrofatty replacement of right ventricular myocardium

common.notes: Common presenting symptom due to arrhythmias
Often related to ventricular arrhythmias or sudden cardiac events
Arrhythmias often triggered by physical activity

occasional.notes: May develop in advanced disease stages
Detected on imaging or during surgery

rare.notes: Often first manifestation in young individuals
Occurs in advanced or biventricular forms

imaging: Echocardiographic evidence of right ventricular dilation and dysfunction
Cardiac MRI showing fibrofatty infiltration and regional wall motion abnormalities
genetic: Pathogenic mutations in desmosomal genes (e.g., PKP2, DSP, DSG2, DSC2, JUP)
other: Electrocardiogram abnormalities including epsilon waves and T wave inversions in V1-V3

distinguishingFeatures: Predominant left ventricular dilation and systolic dysfunction
Benign ventricular tachycardia originating from RVOT
No structural heart disease or fibrofatty infiltration

redFlags: Family history of sudden cardiac death
references: Marcus FI, et al. Diagnosis of arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy/dysplasia: proposed modification of the Task Force Criteria. Circulation. 2010.
Basso C, et al. Arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy. Lancet. 2009.
Corrado D, et al. Arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy: diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment. Heart. 2017.
